checklist.item: Secrets and server texts (tokens, header values, SMTP or upstream replies, file contents) in errors, logs and responses.
checklist.evidence: A proxy in front of the fake incident api answered the console's POST /manual-incidents in 7 hostile ways. 409/400 with markup, a sentinel and the token in ErrorResponse.error: the page shows that text escaped (<img …), raw markup false; the console adds no token itself (note N5). 500 with a sentinel body: 'pulse-api could not save the change (500). Nothing was changed.', sentinel false. 400 without the wire header, 307/302 to a foreign host, 200 with 20 MB and a hostile x-pulse-contract: 'The result is unknown …', sentinel false. Overview with 418 and a markup wire header: no markup, no sentinel. Logs over all cases: token 0, sentinel 0, markup 0. bun src/main.ts with 13 hostile settings (token file too short, placeholder, space, two lines, a directory; env token with a space; bad secret key file; credentials or a query in PULSE_API_URL; credentials in PULSE_CONSOLE_PUBLIC_URL; bad log level; DB path a directory): all exit 2, the message names the setting and the rule, sentinel 0. A full start with setup: the token in neither stdout nor stderr. The leak-scan tests pass (bun test: 1991 pass, 0 fail).

checklist.item: Authentication before any other check; status codes and their order on admin routes.
checklist.evidence: Anonymous: POST /checks/new with a foreign Origin, text/plain and 2 MB -> 303 /sign-in?next=%2Fchecks%2Fnew; POST /team/role 2 MB -> 303; GET /team -> 303; unknown path -> 404; foreign Host -> 421 before the session. Method first, as documented: PUT /team -> 405 Allow: GET, HEAD; DELETE /checks/delete -> 405. Signed in: Viewer with a wrong CSRF -> 403 refused; Viewer with the right CSRF -> 403 access denied (role after CSRF); Owner with a foreign or missing Origin -> 403, text/plain -> 415, 9000 B -> 413, repeated csrf -> 400, 8192 B with a bad CSRF -> 403. The form token is used up last (409, server.form-token.test.ts). Ops routes have no session by design (note N9).

checklist.item: Body and size limits on every method, also before any write.
checklist.evidence: 413 at the documented limits: /team/role 9000 B, /checks/new 600 KB, /incidents/new 40 KB, /sign-in, /invite/<token> and /reset/<token> 10 MB, a 20 KB chunked body. Content-Length 10 followed by 20000 bytes: only 10 bytes are read, 403 at CSRF. POST /sign-in without Origin: 403 before any read. POST /setup after setup: 404. GET / with a 5 MB body: 200, body never read. 64 KB header: 431. Anonymous POSTs never reach a body read. One write comes before the body check: the gate's session touch (src/server.ts:265) updates sessions.last_seen_at 9000000 -> 9120000 and refreshes the cookie with the 413 (note N3).

checklist.item: Input validation at every trust boundary; validators never throw on any input type.
checklist.evidence: 41 validators and parsers x 45 hostile strings: 2 throws, both apiIdSegment with a lone UTF-16 surrogate (URIError). HTTP cannot carry one: %ED%A0%80 in a query becomes U+FFFD (GET /checks/check?id=%ED%A0%80 -> 404). A pulse-api id can (a JSON \u escape): GET /checks and the automatic incident detail answer 500 (SEC-1). Non-string types throw in string-typed helpers, but every reachable input is a string. Duplicate Origin, Content-Type, Host and Cookie headers arrive as one string (first wins), no 500. HTTP/1.0 without Host -> 421. parseForm with __proto__/constructor -> {"a":"1"}, no pollution. safeNext maps /\t/evil, /\evil and //evil to /. checkApiUrl refuses file:, gopher:, credentials, query and fragment. parseUtcTime('2026-02-30T00:00') -> undefined. API answers pass the contract validators (5 MiB limit, no redirect).

checklist.item: No accessor or getter of untrusted input runs.
checklist.evidence: Untrusted data arrives as strings (URLSearchParams, headers, raw path) or as JSON.parse output (data properties only). ROUTES[ctx.path] (src/server.ts:1124): /__proto__, /constructor, /toString, /hasOwnProperty -> 404 (no inherited member has methods); __proto__ and constructor without / -> 400 from the HTTP parser. Form fields are read with Object.hasOwn (check-form.ts:106, token-routes.ts:149, incident-routes.ts:125, maintenance-routes.ts:123), roles with Object.hasOwn(RANK) (roles.ts:24), setting labels with hasOwn (check-detail-pages.ts:157). The export uses Object.fromEntries (check-export.ts:55). Error causes are read as own data properties (api-failure.ts:45, secret-key.ts:11). Lookups by API values take enum values that the contract validated.

checklist.item: SSRF: allowed targets, environment lookups, redirects (cross-origin, https to http), forwarded headers.
checklist.evidence: Targets: only the saved API URL (INSERT once at setup, account-store.ts:187, no UPDATE) or PULSE_API_URL. Every id path segment passes apiIdSegment (. and .. refused), CHANNEL_ID, COMMAND_ID, the window id rule or a number. Setup action=test can send the token to any http(s) URL that the setup-code holder enters (note N10). Redirects: the contract sets redirect: manual (client.ts:114); a 307 and a 302 to another origin on http -> 'The result is unknown'; foreign host requests []; no redirect is followed, so no https-to-http downgrade. Environment: with HTTP_PROXY set, the proxy received GET http://api.invalid:3000/admin/config with the admin token (note N1). Forwarded headers: none read (grep: no 'forwarded' in src); an invite made with X-Forwarded-Host, X-Forwarded-Proto and Forwarded -> http://127.0.0.1:<port>/invite/<token>, evil.example absent.

The only written file is the SQLite database (grep for writeFile, appendFile, createWriteStream and rename in src: none). Changes run in SQLite transactions (41 sites, BEGIN IMMEDIATE for the credential commits), WAL mode. A real start under umask 022: console.db 600, console.db-wal 600, console.db-shm 600. Creation uses O_EXCL (openSync(path, 'wx', 0o600)). A dangling symlink at the path -> exit 2 'cannot open (ENOENT)', nothing created. A symlink to an existing text file: chmod follows the link and sets the target to 600, then exit 2 SQLITE_NOTADB (note N2).

checklist.item: Dependencies, Docker base images and CI actions pinned and approved (docs/approved-packages.md).
checklist.evidence: package.json: pulse-contract and pulse-kit by full SHA (runtime). Dev: @axe-core/playwright 4.14.0, @biomejs/biome 2.6.3, pulse-config by SHA, @types/bun 1.4.0, @types/node 26.6.6, lefthook 2.2.2, playwright 1.64.1, typescript7 npm:typescript@7.0.2. All exact and approved. The production install has 3 packages (pulse-contract, pulse-kit, zod 4.6.7, approved). bun audit: exit 1, 1 moderate in minimatch@10.2.6, dev-only (note N6). Dockerfile: both stages use oven/bun:1.4.0-alpine@sha256:0723557…, approved. Built image: uid 1000, Cmd bun --no-env-file src/main.ts, node_modules @lorenzh/{pulse-contract,pulse-kit} + zod, no git, 0 test files. The build stage installs git unpinned (note N8). CI: permissions contents: read; actions/checkout@3d3c42e (v7.0.1) with persist-credentials: false, oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e (v2.2.0); check.yml and release.yml at pulse-config 04108fa pin the same SHAs plus actions/attest@1e69f48 and moby/buildkit v0.34.1 by digest. All approved. pulse-workflows: ok (1 files, 11 uses). deploy-dev checks out 5 repositories at ref main (note N7). Trigger pull_request, not pull_request_target.

findings.title: An API check id with a lone UTF-16 surrogate makes GET /checks and the automatic incident detail answer 500 (URIError in encodeURIComponent)
findings.class: Encoder that throws on input that a validator let through: encodeURIComponent in idQuery (src/check-pages.ts:126) and apiIdSegment (src/api-path.ts:8, called at src/incident-read.ts:172 and src/check-detail-pages.ts:235). The contract check id rule is any non-empty string.
findings.command: Fake pulse-api whose /admin/config and /checks hold one check id ending in a lone surrogate (JSON \u escape); GET /, /checks, /checks/check?id=web as Owner. Second fake with an automatic incident on such a check id; GET /incidents and /incidents/automatic?id=<n> as Viewer.
findings.excerpt: GET /checks (first check id ends in a lone surrogate): 500 "internal error\n"; GET /incidents/automatic?id=8: 500 text/plain; log {"msg":"request failed","error":"URIError"}; GET / and GET /incidents: 200
findings.impact: Whoever can define a check id through pulse-api's checks file, or an api that answers with such an id, takes the Checks list down for every console user until the id is gone. Console forms cannot send such an id.
findings.fixDirection: Treat ids that are not well-formed UTF-16 like the unaddressable ids . and ..: show them as text without a link and call no API for them. Or make the contract id rule refuse them. Add tests on the list, detail and incident pages.

findings.title: Filling the pre-session form-token pool from one unauthenticated client expires everyone's open sign-in, setup and link forms (409)
findings.class: Unauthenticated resource exhaustion of a shared bounded store (availability): FORM_TOKEN_ANON_MAX = 2000 (src/form-tokens.ts:4), a full pool drops its globally oldest entry (src/form-tokens.ts:93), and every anonymous form-page GET issues a token (src/server.ts:420).
findings.command: Signed-in-console fixture: open the sign-in form as the victim client, fill the pre-session pool from a second client with anonymous form-page GETs (once below and once at the documented bound), then send the victim's correct credentials with its earlier token.
findings.excerpt: correct sign-in after 1900 anonymous GET /sign-in from another client (219 ms): 303 expired=false; correct sign-in after 2000 anonymous GET /sign-in from another client (262 ms): 409 expired=true
findings.impact: One unauthenticated client that keeps the pool full makes every correct sign-in, setup-code entry and invite or reset form answer 409 'This form has expired', over and over. Nobody can sign in during the flood. Signed-in pages are not affected (separate pool).
findings.fixDirection: Do not let one client push out the tokens of others: bound anonymous tokens per client address (the socket peer, as the throttle does), or evict from the largest binding instead of the globally oldest entry. Or make a pre-session token verifiable without the store (HMAC of binding, path and time, plus a used-token list). Add a test where a second client fills the pool.

notes.text: Bun's fetch uses HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/NO_PROXY from the environment for every pulse-api call. With HTTP_PROXY set and an http API URL, the proxy received GET http://api.invalid:3000/admin/config with the admin bearer token. Docker sets these variables in a container when the client config has proxies. The docs do not mention proxies.

chmodSync on an existing DB path follows a symlink: the target of a symlink at PULSE_CONSOLE_DB went from 644 to 600 before the start failed with SQLITE_NOTADB. The mode only gets stricter, and planting the link needs write access to the data directory.

The access gate touches a full session older than 60 s before Origin, content type and body limit, so an oversized POST from a signed-in browser updates sessions.last_seen_at and refreshes the cookie with its 413. This follows the documented order (gate first); no request state is saved.

Loopback mode is not access control: with PULSE_CONSOLE_HOST=0.0.0.0 and no public URL, GET /setup over a non-loopback address gave 421 with its own Host and 200 with Host: 127.0.0.1. The image binds 0.0.0.0; the README says to publish on host loopback only.

On a refused write from a pulse-api that sends the wire header, the page shows the api's ErrorResponse.error text (at most 1000 characters, escaped), by design (R8). Without the wire header, for 5xx and for redirects, only fixed texts appear.
bun audit: 1 moderate advisory, minimatch@10.2.6 (GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249), reached only through eslint in the dev dependency pulse-config. Not in the production install or the image.
deploy-dev checks out pulse-deploy, api, probe, status and notify at ref main (mutable). It runs with contents: read, no secrets and persist-credentials: false; release does not need it.
The build stage runs apk add --no-cache git without a version (git is not in the final image). The browser job's bunx playwright install downloads a Chromium that no hash pins.
/healthz, /readyz and /metrics answer without a session and outside the loopback Host rule, as documented. /metrics holds counters by fixed path label and auth result only.

Before setup, whoever holds the setup grant can make the console send GET <url>/admin/config with the admin token to any http(s) URL, including link-local addresses, and the answer texts tell reachable from unreachable apart. The setup code is the trust root here, by design.

The sign-in throttle locks an account after 5 failures in 15 minutes and keys clients by socket peer, so behind a reverse proxy all clients share one key. Both are documented (docs/configuration.md:175).
